categories.main_business_segments: Hynar Water Group primarily operates in ecological protection and environmental governance, focusing on industrial wastewater treatment and high-quality water supply. The company integrates intelligent equipment, new materials, and water treatment chemicals to provide comprehensive solutions including R&D, design, investment, construction, and operation. It also engages in sludge treatment and disposal, smart water management, and related environmental services.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced technologies such as TEPS (Total Equilibrium Process based Services) for pollution control, heterogeneous Fenton catalytic oxidation, electrochemical coupled hydrolysis acidification, MBBR (Moving Bed Biofilm Reactor), ozone contact oxidation, and membrane filtration technologies including ultrafiltration, nanofiltration, and reverse osmosis. It also develops smart water management platforms using IoT, cloud computing, AI, and digital twin technologies to optimize water treatment and resource utilization.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Hynar serves government entities, industrial parks, and enterprises in sectors such as coal chemical, petrochemical, fine chemical, pharmaceuticals, textiles, power, steel, papermaking, electronics, and food processing. Its markets include municipal and industrial wastewater treatment, high-quality drinking water supply, and direct pipeline drinking water projects, primarily targeting urban and industrial customers.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates nationwide across China with strategic presence in key regions including the Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei area, Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area, Yangtze River Delta, Central China urban clusters, and the Zhongyuan Economic Zone. It has established 31 subsidiaries and projects spanning these major economic regions.
categories.supply_chain_position: Hynar Water Group operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the water treatment supply chain, focusing on investment, construction, and operation of water and wastewater treatment facilities. It also engages in upstream R&D and manufacturing of intelligent equipment and water treatment chemicals, integrating the full industry chain from technology development to service delivery.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes technology-driven innovation with a focus on green, low-carbon, and resource-efficient water treatment technologies. It invests in R&D centers and collaborates with leading universities to develop advanced catalytic oxidation, biological treatment, and smart water management systems. Strategic priorities include expanding smart water services, integrating AI and digital platforms, and developing new materials and equipment to support sustainable environmental governance and carbon neutrality goals.
categories.revenue_model: Hynar generates revenue through multiple streams including engineering construction contracts (EPC, BOT, ROT), operation and maintenance services of water treatment facilities, and sales of water treatment chemicals and intelligent equipment. Revenue is recognized based on contract progress for construction and on service delivery and water usage for operational projects, with fees often structured around guaranteed minimum volumes and usage-based charges.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company positions itself as a leading integrated ecological environment and smart governance provider in China’s water treatment sector. It competes with other large environmental service providers in industrial wastewater treatment and municipal water supply, leveraging its comprehensive service capabilities, technological innovation, and nationwide project portfolio to maintain a competitive edge.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Hynar reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 371.8 million, a 21.29% decrease from the previous year, and a net loss attributable to shareholders of RMB 247.16 million, significantly impacted by market conditions and asset impairments. The company’s total assets stood at RMB 2.7 billion with a net asset value of RMB 757.5 million. Despite recent financial challenges, it maintains a broad project base and continues to invest in R&D and strategic initiatives for future growth.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Hynar emphasizes its integrated, technology-driven approach combining advanced water treatment processes with smart management platforms to deliver efficient, cost-effective, and environmentally sustainable solutions. Its TEPS pollution control model, proprietary catalytic technologies, and AI-enabled smart water systems differentiate it by enhancing treatment effectiveness, reducing operational costs, and supporting clients’ carbon reduction and resource recycling goals.
